newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain 1998 electric tariff may drop by over 2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain 1998 electric tariff may drop by over 2 pct.

text.p: Spanish electricity tariffs may fall by more than the nominal two percent reduction originally foreseen in 1998, Energy Secretary Nemesio Fernandez Cuesta said on Thursday.
"It's possible that (tariffs) may fall in excess of two percent next year," he told journalists at a meeting.
December's electricity protocol, which laid down guidelines to open the sector to competition, fixed a two percent nominal reduction in electricity tariffs in 1998.
However, it also stipulated that the reduction could be higher if demand grows by more than 3.5 percent, if interest rates fall below 6.5 percent, or if effective subsidies are reduced.
Fernandez Cuesta said it would at least appear than the interest rate criteria will be fulfilled.
Next year's tariff will likely be announced in the autumn, he added.
